newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia Unibanka shareholders to decide merger.
newsitem.headline: Latvia Unibanka shareholders to decide merger.

text.p: Shareholders of one of the leading banks in Latvia, Unibanka, are to decide on a merger with another commercial bank, Zemes Bank, at a meeting on March 25, the stock exchange said on Thursday.

The stock exchange in a statement gave the agenda for the shareholders' meeting, which includes a review of the 1996 accounts, a decision on distributing 1996 profits and the plans of the bank and budget for 1997.
The merger with Zemes Bank was announced in December and is the first among Latvia's top banks.
The bourse said the Unibanka shareholders' meeting would also choose the auditors for 1997 and decide on an increase in share capital and the necessary changes in the company's statutes.
Unibanka is one of the leading shares on the Latvian stock exchange and has major Western investors such as the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and Swedfund.
